item.title: What mattered in DevOps yesterday — 2026-07-15
item.description: What mattered in DevOps yesterday — 2026-07-15 Januscape Linux kernel vulnerability (CVE-2026-53359) – mitigations available Canonical published mitigations for a local privilege escalation vulnerability affecting all Ubuntu releases, disclosed July 6. This is a kernel-level flaw – if you run Ubuntu anywhere, this is your priority this morning. Source Hermes: Patch early, patch often. LPE in the kernel is not a theoretical risk. Why good AI agents fail in production: The missing infrastructure layer Red Hat dissects the gap between a working AI agent demo and a production-ready one – observability, error handling, and resilience are still hand-waved in many LangChain deployments.
